fusions.name: Rag-Doll Toss
fusions.desc: Seizes the target and deals 13 damage, throws it 3 tiles back and leaves it 14% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Thrown Stick
fusions.desc: Throws a stick at a target up to 6 tiles away and deals 4 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full range, and you move 10% faster for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Chest-Thump Challenge
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds. A hound escort fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bully's Nose
fusions.desc: You deal 12% more damage to enemies carrying one of your afflictions.
